TempStatusWnd instance 0x8BCD48, vtable 0x639CD4, target self+0x1B8=0x8BCF00, visible self+0x84=0x8BCDCC. Existing adapter owns this exact instance/vtable/target/epoch, checks UI thread and reentrancy. Verified opening 0x55BAB0 ABI from saved assembly: EAX=display, ECX=y, EDX=x, stack=definition, RET 4. It calls 0x55BC60 with arg 0 and normal opening performs synchronous rendering; an early hide-only path exists. Hide 0x55B590 uses ECX=self, stack 0, RET 4. Do not transfer these contracts to another function merely because it opens details.

Ordinary StatusWnd instance 0x67E978, vtable 0x639C5C, target 0x67EB30. Saved 0x55B5B0 is an ordinary opening route, directly called from saved 0x4CA260 and 0x41A7A0. It closes Temp and several other windows, changes target/location-related state, positions/redraws views and may call 0x418EE0. Ordinary hide 0x55B430 also has map/window side effects. Exact 0x55B5B0 ABI is not established by its decompiler signature (unaff_retaddr and recovered arguments are not trustworthy). It is not a drop-in 0x55BAB0 replacement.
- [research/recovered/outside_dev1/reports/017_WORK_V4_REVIEW_LOCATION_CUSTOM_COLUMNS_20261029.md:163](../../research/recovered/outside_dev1/reports/017_WORK_V4_REVIEW_LOCATION_CUSTOM_COLUMNS_20261029.md?plain=1#L163-L163) — Current core/dat_ui_v4_visuals.h and work_selector_native_detail.h still open 0x55BAB0/Temp, using EAX display value 0x80000008, ECX y, EDX x, stack definition. Their tick checks epoch/target/lifetime and does not close merely on mouse leaving a row. The native Temp branch already avoids the action body. This is a viable alternative only if the actual interaction is pinned on row click and remains visible while the cursor moves into it. The display sentinel is not proven to mean infinite persistence: 0x55BAB0 substitutes a default from self+0xE4 and stores +0xE0. Do not claim pinning solely from this constant.
